description.en:
Basic Attack - Huntress

Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.

Heavy Attack - Huntress

Hold Normal Attack to continuously fire at enemies at the cost of STA, dealing Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
- Hold and then release Normal Attack while Rebecca is not casting Tactical Dodge - Huntress to cast Heavy Attack - Eat Lead!: Huntress

Heavy Attack - Eat Lead!: Huntress

Deal Electro DMG.

Comin' in Hot! - Huntress

Somersault in mid-air and land.
Keep holding Normal Attack after casting this skill to follow up with Heavy Attack - Huntress without consuming STA.

Mid-air Plunging Attack - Huntress

Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Electro DMG.

Dodge Counter - Huntress

Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to strike the target, dealing Electro DMG.

Tactical Dodge - Huntress

Press Dodge to attack the target while dodging, dealing Electro DMG.
Can be cast during the following actions (while on the ground):
- Performing Basic Attack - Huntress.
- Performing Heavy Attack - Huntress.
- Performing Heavy Attack - Eat Lead!: Huntress
- Casting Comin' in Hot! - Huntress.
- Casting Tactical Dodge - Huntress.
- Casting Resonance Skill.
- Casting Intro Skill.
Additional Electro DMG is dealt upon a successful Dodge during Tactical Dodge - Huntress.
Keep holding Normal Attack after casting this skill to follow up with Heavy Attack - Huntress without consuming STA.

Basic Attack - Guts

Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.
Casting Tactical Dodge - Guts does not reset Basic Attack - Huntress's attack cycle within a certain time.

Heavy Attack - Guts

Consume STA and attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.

Mid-air Plunging Attack - Guts

Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Electro DMG.

Dodge Counter - Guts

Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to strike the target, dealing Electro DMG.

Tactical Dodge - Guts

Press Dodge and attack the target while dodging, dealing Electro DMG.
Can be cast during the following actions (while on the ground):
- Performing Basic Attack - Guts.
- Casting Tactical Dodge - Guts.
- Casting Resonance Skill.
- Casting Intro Skill.
Additional Electro DMG is dealt upon a successful Dodge during Tactical Dodge - Guts.
description.id:
Basic Attack - Huntress

Melakukan hingga 3 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Electro DMG.

Heavy Attack - Huntress

Tahan Normal Attack untuk terus menembaki musuh dengan mengonsumsi STA, memberikan Electro DMG, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.
- Tahan lalu lepas Normal Attack saat Rebecca tidak sedang menggunakan Tactical Dodge - Huntress untuk melancarkan Heavy Attack - Eat Lead!: Huntress

Heavy Attack - Eat Lead!: Huntress

Memberikan Electro DMG.

Comin' in Hot! - Huntress

Jungkir balik di udara lalu mendarat.
Terus tahan Normal Attack setelah menggunakan skill ini untuk menyambung dengan Heavy Attack - Huntress tanpa mengonsumsi STA.

Mid-air Plunging Attack - Huntress

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack, memberikan Electro DMG.

Dodge Counter - Huntress

Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Electro DMG.

Tactical Dodge - Huntress

Tekan Dodge untuk menyerang target sambil menghindar, memberikan Electro DMG.
Dapat digunakan selama aksi berikut (saat di darat):
- Melakukan Basic Attack - Huntress.
- Melakukan Heavy Attack - Huntress.
- Melakukan Heavy Attack - Eat Lead!: Huntress
- Menggunakan Comin' in Hot! - Huntress.
- Menggunakan Tactical Dodge - Huntress.
- Menggunakan Resonance Skill.
- Menggunakan Intro Skill.
Tambahan Electro DMG diberikan saat Dodge berhasil selama Tactical Dodge - Huntress.
Terus tahan Normal Attack setelah menggunakan skill ini untuk menyambung dengan Heavy Attack - Huntress tanpa mengonsumsi STA.

Basic Attack - Guts

Melakukan hingga 3 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Electro DMG.
Menggunakan Tactical Dodge - Guts tidak mengatur ulang siklus serangan Basic Attack - Huntress dalam waktu tertentu.

Heavy Attack - Guts

Mengonsumsi STA dan menyerang target, memberikan Electro DMG.

Mid-air Plunging Attack - Guts

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack, memberikan Electro DMG.

Dodge Counter - Guts

Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Electro DMG.

Tactical Dodge - Guts

Tekan Dodge dan serang target sambil menghindar, memberikan Electro DMG.
Dapat digunakan selama aksi berikut (saat di darat):
- Melakukan Basic Attack - Guts.
- Menggunakan Tactical Dodge - Guts.
- Menggunakan Resonance Skill.
- Menggunakan Intro Skill.
Tambahan Electro DMG diberikan saat Dodge berhasil selama Tactical Dodge - Guts.

description.en:
Resonance Skill - It's Big Boomin' Time!

Press Resonance Skill when in the Huntress mode to close the distance and spray lead at enemies, then switch to the Guts mode to blast the target, dealing Electro DMG.

Resonance Skill - Come 'n' Get Me!

Press Resonance Skill when in the Guts mode to spray lead at the enemy, then use recoil from shooting the ground to close the distance and switch to Huntress mode to continue the barrage, dealing Electro DMG.
Press or hold Normal Attack when close to the ground shortly after casting this skill to follow up with Comin' in Hot! - Huntress.
description.id:
Resonance Skill - It's Big Boomin' Time!

Tekan Resonance Skill saat dalam mode Huntress untuk mendekati musuh dan memberondongnya dengan peluru, lalu beralih ke mode Guts untuk meledakkan target, memberikan Electro DMG.

Resonance Skill - Come 'n' Get Me!

Tekan Resonance Skill saat dalam mode Guts untuk memberondong musuh dengan peluru, lalu memanfaatkan hentakan dari menembak tanah untuk mendekat dan beralih ke mode Huntress guna melanjutkan rentetan tembakan, memberikan Electro DMG.
Tekan atau tahan Normal Attack saat dekat dengan tanah sesaat setelah menggunakan skill ini untuk menyambung dengan Comin' in Hot! - Huntress.

description.en:
Switching to Mk. 31 HMG mode generates a field of Stagnation for 9.5s, in which:
Rebecca fires the Mk. 31 HMG automatically, dealing Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG, while accumulating Overload. Press or hold Normal Attack or press Resonance Liberation at intervals after Rebecca starts firing to enhance her Mk. 31 HMG's firepower and accumulate Overload faster. This effect can be triggered up to 2 times.
- The machine gun will only auto-lock onto the enemy closest to the crosshair in the aim down sight.
- Rebecca is immobile when firing the Mk. 31 HMG and gains 50% DMG Reduction and Immunity to Interrruption.

Overload

Rebecca can hold up to 90 points of Overload.
Hitting targets with the standard firepower Mk. 31 HMG grants 2 points.
Hitting targets with the enhanced firepower Mk. 31 HMG grants 4 points.
Hitting targets with the twice-enhanced firepower Mk. 31 HMG grants 6 points.

BOOM! Fireworks!

After Mk. 31 HMG mode ends or when Overload is maxed, BOOM! Fireworks! is automatically cast, dealing Electro DMG. Casting BOOM! Fireworks! ends Mk. 31 HMG.
- Hold Resonance Liberation while in Mk. 31 HMG mode to immediatly cast BOOM! Fireworks!.
- Leaving the Mk. 31 HMG mode removes all Overload.
description.id:
Beralih ke mode Mk. 31 HMG menghasilkan medan Stagnation selama 9,5 dtk, di mana:
Rebecca menembakkan Mk. 31 HMG secara otomatis, memberikan Electro DMG, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG, sambil mengumpulkan Overload. Tekan atau tahan Normal Attack atau tekan Resonance Liberation secara berkala setelah Rebecca mulai menembak untuk meningkatkan daya tembak Mk. 31 HMG-nya dan mengumpulkan Overload lebih cepat. Efek ini dapat terpicu hingga 2 kali.
- Senapan mesin hanya akan mengunci otomatis musuh yang paling dekat dengan crosshair saat membidik.
- Rebecca tidak dapat bergerak saat menembakkan Mk. 31 HMG dan mendapat 50% DMG Reduction serta kekebalan terhadap interupsi.

Overload

Rebecca dapat menyimpan hingga 90 poin Overload.
Mengenai target dengan Mk. 31 HMG berdaya tembak standar memberikan 2 poin.
Mengenai target dengan Mk. 31 HMG berdaya tembak ditingkatkan memberikan 4 poin.
Mengenai target dengan Mk. 31 HMG berdaya tembak ditingkatkan dua kali memberikan 6 poin.

BOOM! Fireworks!

Setelah mode Mk. 31 HMG berakhir atau saat Overload penuh, BOOM! Fireworks! digunakan secara otomatis, memberikan Electro DMG. Menggunakan BOOM! Fireworks! mengakhiri Mk. 31 HMG.
- Tahan Resonance Liberation saat dalam mode Mk. 31 HMG untuk langsung menggunakan BOOM! Fireworks!.
- Keluar dari mode Mk. 31 HMG menghapus seluruh Overload.

description.en:
ATK is increased by 10% for 12s when A Girl Gets What She Wants! is triggered, or when Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress or Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts is cast, stacking up to 2 times.
When a Resonator in the team inflicts Hack - Shifting, their Tune Break Boost is increased by 30 for 30s.
description.id:
ATK meningkat sebesar 10% selama 12 dtk saat A Girl Gets What She Wants! terpicu, atau saat Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress atau Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts digunakan, bertumpuk hingga 2 kali.
Saat Resonator dalam tim menimbulkan Hack - Shifting, Tune Break Boost mereka meningkat sebesar 30 selama 30 dtk.

description.en:
Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress and Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts gain increased resistance to interruption.
When Rebecca casts Resonance Liberation - Party 'til Dawn!, the ATK of all nearby Resonators in the team is increased by 20% for 30s.
description.id:
Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress dan Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts mendapat ketahanan lebih tinggi terhadap interupsi.
Saat Rebecca menggunakan Resonance Liberation - Party 'til Dawn!, ATK semua Resonator di sekitar dalam tim meningkat sebesar 20% selama 30 dtk.

description.en:
Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time!

When in the Huntress mode, upon casting Intro Skill, Rebecca approaches the enemy and sprays lead with Huntress, then switches to the Guts mode to blast the target, dealing Electro DMG.

Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!

When in the Guts mode, upon casting Intro Skill, Rebecca approaches the enemy using the recoil of Guts from shooting the ground and switches to the Huntress mode to spray lead at the enemy, dealing Electro DMG.
Press or hold Normal Attack when close to the ground shortly after casting this skill to follow up with Comin' in Hot! - Huntress.

Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time!

Saat dalam mode Huntress, ketika Intro Skill digunakan, Rebecca mendekati musuh dan memberondongnya dengan peluru lewat Huntress, lalu beralih ke mode Guts untuk meledakkan target, memberikan Electro DMG.

Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!

Saat dalam mode Guts, ketika Intro Skill digunakan, Rebecca mendekati musuh dengan memanfaatkan hentakan Guts dari menembak tanah dan beralih ke mode Huntress untuk memberondong musuh dengan peluru, memberikan Electro DMG.
Tekan atau tahan Normal Attack saat dekat dengan tanah sesaat setelah menggunakan skill ini untuk menyambung dengan Comin' in Hot! - Huntress.

description.en:
Switch Gears!

Upon casting Resonance Skill or Intro Skill, Rebecca can freely switch between the Huntress and Guts modes.
- The Huntress mode increases Rebecca's Crit. DMG by 30%.
- The Guts mode allows Rebecca to ignore 15% of the target's DEF.
By default, Rebecca starts in the Huntress mode.

Hack - Shifting

Rebecca inflicts Hack - Shifting upon dealing damage to the targets through the following skills. The same skill can trigger this effect once every 3s:
Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time!, Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!, Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress, Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts, and Resonance Liberation - BOOM! Fireworks!.

Hack Response - Meltdown

Deal Electro DMG to all targets affected by Hack - Interfered within the range, considered Hack DMG.

Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress

At 120 points of Fervor, Heavy Attack - Huntress is replaced with Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress. Hold Normal Attack to cast Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress, which consumes all Fervor to pull in nearby targets and deal Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
During Heavy Attack - Huntress, if Fervor is at 120 points and Rebecca is not in the action of Tactical Dodge - Huntress, release Normal Attack to cast Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress.

Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts

At 120 points of Fervor, Heavy Attack - Guts is replaced with Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts. Hold Normal Attack to cast Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts, which consumes all Fervor to pull in nearby targets and deal Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.

Fervor

Rebecca can hold up to 120 points of Fervor.
Normal Attacks restore Fervor upon damaging the target.
Resonance Skill restores Fervor upon damaging the target.
When A Girl Gets What She Wants! is gained by casting Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time! or Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!, Rebecca restores 50 points of Fervor.

Hot Hand

Rebecca can hold up to 120 points of Hot Hand.
Regenerates over time at a rate of 10 points per second.
Casting Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress or Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts restores 40 points.

A Girl Gets What She Wants!

At 120 points of Hot Hand, casting Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time!, Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!, Resonance Skill - It's Big Boomin' Time!, or Resonance Skill - Come 'n' Get Me! grants the following effects for 12s:
Rebecca simultaneously gains the Stat Bonuses of both the Huntress and Guts modes, regardless of which mode she's currently in.
Hot Hand cannot be restored during this period and is consumed by 10 points per second.
description.id:
Switch Gears!

Saat menggunakan Resonance Skill atau Intro Skill, Rebecca dapat bebas beralih antara mode Huntress dan Guts.
- Mode Huntress meningkatkan Crit. DMG Rebecca sebesar 30%.
- Mode Guts membuat Rebecca mengabaikan 15% DEF target.
Secara default, Rebecca memulai dalam mode Huntress.

Hack - Shifting

Rebecca menimbulkan Hack - Shifting saat memberikan damage ke target melalui skill berikut. Skill yang sama dapat memicu efek ini sekali setiap 3 dtk:
Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time!, Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!, Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress, Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts, dan Resonance Liberation - BOOM! Fireworks!.

Hack Response - Meltdown

Memberikan Electro DMG ke semua target yang terkena Hack - Interfered dalam jangkauan, dianggap sebagai Hack DMG.

Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress

Pada 120 poin Fervor, Heavy Attack - Huntress digantikan oleh Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress. Tahan Normal Attack untuk menggunakan Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress, yang mengonsumsi seluruh Fervor untuk menarik target di sekitar dan memberikan Electro DMG, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.
Selama Heavy Attack - Huntress, jika Fervor berada di 120 poin dan Rebecca tidak sedang melakukan Tactical Dodge - Huntress, lepas Normal Attack untuk menggunakan Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress.

Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts

Pada 120 poin Fervor, Heavy Attack - Guts digantikan oleh Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts. Tahan Normal Attack untuk menggunakan Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts, yang mengonsumsi seluruh Fervor untuk menarik target di sekitar dan memberikan Electro DMG, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.

Fervor

Rebecca dapat menyimpan hingga 120 poin Fervor.
Normal Attack memulihkan Fervor saat mengenai target.
Resonance Skill memulihkan Fervor saat mengenai target.
Saat A Girl Gets What She Wants! didapat dengan menggunakan Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time! atau Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!, Rebecca memulihkan 50 poin Fervor.

Hot Hand

Rebecca dapat menyimpan hingga 120 poin Hot Hand.
Pulih seiring waktu sebesar 10 poin per detik.
Menggunakan Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress atau Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts memulihkan 40 poin.

A Girl Gets What She Wants!

Pada 120 poin Hot Hand, menggunakan Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time!, Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!, Resonance Skill - It's Big Boomin' Time!, atau Resonance Skill - Come 'n' Get Me! memberikan efek berikut selama 12 dtk:
Rebecca mendapat Stat Bonus dari mode Huntress dan Guts sekaligus, terlepas dari mode yang sedang aktif.
Hot Hand tidak dapat dipulihkan selama periode ini dan dikonsumsi sebesar 10 poin per detik.

description.en:
Summon a turret that continuously attacks enemies for 14s, dealing 2.5% Electro DMG each hit.
The incoming Resonator gains Edgerunner Bonds, granting 15% All DMG Amplification for 14s. Resonators with Edgerunner Bonds gain 1 stacks of Overlimit every 0.2s, each stack granting 0.5% Heavy Attack DMG Amplification, up to 35% (Lucy automatically receives max stacks when her Edgerunner Bonds is active). Switching to another Resonator ends Edgerunner Bonds and Overlimit early.
Lucy can enhance the turret, increasing its DMG Multiplier by 250%, but its on-field duration will be lowered to 4s.
description.id:
Memanggil turret yang terus menyerang musuh selama 14 dtk, memberikan 2,5% Electro DMG setiap serangan.
Resonator yang masuk mendapat Edgerunner Bonds, memberikan 15% All DMG Amplification selama 14 dtk. Resonator dengan Edgerunner Bonds mendapat 1 stack Overlimit setiap 0,2 dtk, setiap stack memberikan 0,5% Heavy Attack DMG Amplification, hingga 35% (Lucy otomatis mendapat stack maksimum saat Edgerunner Bonds-nya aktif). Berganti ke Resonator lain mengakhiri Edgerunner Bonds dan Overlimit lebih awal.
Lucy dapat meningkatkan turret, menambah Pengali DMG-nya sebesar 250%, tetapi durasinya di lapangan berkurang menjadi 4 dtk.

description.en:
When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, Rebecca can cast Tune Break on the target.

Rebecca can inflict Hack - Shifting and respond to Hack - Interfered on targets.
Responding to Hack - Interfered: When any Resonator in the team deals Tune Break DMG and inflicts the Hack - Interfered, Rebecca triggers Hack - Meltdown on the target. Each target can be damaged by this skill up to once every 8s.
description.id:
Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Rebecca dapat melakukan Tune Break pada target.

Rebecca dapat menimbulkan Hack - Shifting dan merespons Hack - Interfered pada target.
Merespons Hack - Interfered: Saat Resonator mana pun dalam tim memberikan Tune Break DMG dan menimbulkan Hack - Interfered, Rebecca memicu Hack - Meltdown pada target. Setiap target hanya dapat terkena damage dari skill ini sekali setiap 8 dtk.

description.en:
The DMG Multipliers of the following skills are increased by 50%:
- Basic Attack - Huntress, Heavy Attack - Huntress, Tactical Dodge - Huntress, and Dodge Counter - Huntress
- Basic Attack - Guts, Tactical Dodge - Guts, Dodge Counter - Guts.
When A Girl Gets What She Wants! is triggered, Rebecca gains 3 additional stack of Street Smarts for 12s. Upon performing Tactical Dodge - Huntress or Tactical Dodge - Guts, if Rebecca has sufficient Street Smarts stacks, 1 stack will be consumed to restore 20 STA.
Resonance Liberation BOOM! Fireworks! is immune to interruption.
description.id:
Pengali DMG skill berikut meningkat sebesar 50%:
- Basic Attack - Huntress, Heavy Attack - Huntress, Tactical Dodge - Huntress, dan Dodge Counter - Huntress
- Basic Attack - Guts, Tactical Dodge - Guts, Dodge Counter - Guts.
Saat A Girl Gets What She Wants! terpicu, Rebecca mendapat tambahan 3 stack Street Smarts selama 12 dtk. Saat melakukan Tactical Dodge - Huntress atau Tactical Dodge - Guts, jika Rebecca memiliki stack Street Smarts yang cukup, 1 stack akan dikonsumsi untuk memulihkan 20 STA.
Resonance Liberation BOOM! Fireworks! kebal terhadap interupsi.

description.en:
Casting Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time!, Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!, or Resonance Liberation - Party 'til Dawn! grants 20% All-Attribute DMG Bonus for all Resonators in the team for 30s.
When Resonators in the team inflict Hack - Shifting, they gain 15% All DMG Amplification for 30s.
Hot Hand regenerates twice as fast when Rebecca is out of combat.
description.id:
Menggunakan Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time!, Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!, atau Resonance Liberation - Party 'til Dawn! memberikan 20% All-Attribute DMG Bonus untuk semua Resonator dalam tim selama 30 dtk.
Saat Resonator dalam tim menimbulkan Hack - Shifting, mereka mendapat 15% All DMG Amplification selama 30 dtk.
Hot Hand pulih dua kali lebih cepat saat Rebecca di luar pertempuran.

description.en:
Rebecca's Resonance Liberation - Party 'til Dawn!, and Resonance Liberation - BOOM! Fireworks! gain 60% DMG Multiplier increase.
Rebecca's Resonance Liberation - Party 'til Dawn! gains 30% more explosion range.
Casting Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time! or Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me! grants 120 points of Hot Hand.
description.id:
Resonance Liberation - Party 'til Dawn! dan Resonance Liberation - BOOM! Fireworks! Rebecca mendapat peningkatan Pengali DMG sebesar 60%.
Resonance Liberation - Party 'til Dawn! Rebecca mendapat jangkauan ledakan 30% lebih luas.
Menggunakan Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time! atau Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me! memberikan 120 poin Hot Hand.

description.en: Rebecca gains an additional 60% Stat Bonus increase from the A Girl Gets What She Wants! effect.
description.id: Rebecca mendapat tambahan peningkatan Stat Bonus sebesar 60% dari efek A Girl Gets What She Wants!.

description.en: Rebecca gains 20% Basic Attack DMG Bonus for 8s when she inflicts Hack - Shifting.
description.id: Rebecca mendapat 20% Basic Attack DMG Bonus selama 8 dtk saat ia menimbulkan Hack - Shifting.

description.en:
Rebecca's Basic Attack DMG Bonus from every source is increased by 40%.
During Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress or Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts, Rebecca deals an additional instance of Electro DMG equal to 900% of her ATK, considered Basic Attack DMG.
Rebecca recovers an additional 20 points of Hot Hand when she is casting Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress or Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts.
When Rebecca takes a fatal blow, she does not fall to the damage and instead restores fixed 2077 HP for 5 times immediately. This effect is triggered once every 10 min.
When Rebecca stays out of combat for more than 4s, she restores 120 point of Fervor. This effect is triggered once every 4s.
description.id:
Basic Attack DMG Bonus Rebecca dari semua sumber meningkat sebesar 40%.
Selama Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress atau Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts, Rebecca memberikan satu instans tambahan Electro DMG sebesar 900% ATK-nya, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.
Rebecca memulihkan tambahan 20 poin Hot Hand saat menggunakan Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress atau Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts.
Saat Rebecca menerima serangan fatal, ia tidak tumbang dan sebagai gantinya langsung memulihkan 2077 HP tetap sebanyak 5 kali. Efek ini terpicu sekali setiap 10 menit.
Saat Rebecca tetap di luar pertempuran lebih dari 4 dtk, ia memulihkan 120 poin Fervor. Efek ini terpicu sekali setiap 4 dtk.
